mentions.name: Personal website/blog (philliprhodes.name)
mentions.description: Self-hosted personal website/blog deployed with Ansible automation on Tomcat using Roller Weblogger, intended to become the author's main outlet for sharing content alongside Fediverse sites instead of Facebook.
mentions.problem: Replaces closed-source, walled-garden sites like Facebook, in line with the author's principles, while cutting down time wasted on political discussions and improving mental health.
mentions.audience: The author personally, as a self-hosted platform for blogging and sharing content in place of Facebook
mentions.source_excerpt: I spent the weekend working on the Ansible automation needed to deploy Tomcat and Roller Weblogger for my new personal website/blog[1].

evidence.value: I spent the weekend working on the Ansible automation needed to deploy Tomcat and Roller Weblogger for my new personal website/blog[1].
